Seminars & Instructor Programme

Bring Cho Gar Wing Chun to Your Country

Cho Gar Wing Chun seminars are available across Europe. Invite Sifu Nils Ring to teach at your school, or apply for the Cho Gar Wing Chun Instructor Programme.

Seminars

Invite Sifu Nils Ring

As the Official Representative of Cho Gar Wing Chun in Germany, Sifu Nils Ring travels across Europe to teach seminars — bringing this rare, authentic lineage directly to your school or club.

🥋

Authentic Curriculum

Learn genuine Cho Gar Wing Chun forms, concepts and applications directly from a certified Cho Family lineage member.

🌍

Hosted Across Europe

Seminars can be hosted at your school, club or event, anywhere in Europe.

🤝

For All Levels

Open to Wing Chun practitioners and instructors from any background or lineage.

Instructor Programme

Become a Certified Cho Gar Wing Chun Instructor

For dedicated practitioners who want to teach authentic Cho Gar Wing Chun in their own country, under the guidance of the Cho family lineage.

🎓

A Structured Path

The Cho Gar Wing Chun Instructor Programme is a structured path for serious students to deepen their skill and, over time, earn the credentials to teach this rare system in their own region.

🇪🇺

Growing Cho Gar in Europe

Instructor Programme graduates help responsibly grow Cho Gar Wing Chun across Europe, while preserving its authenticity and staying connected to the Cho family lineage.
